snippet.title: Doodle Harmony Idle Merge Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Doodle Harmony Idle Merge is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Generate doodles or purchase them in the store. Customize your experience with a dark mode and a music selector. As you progress, you unlock new doodles, merge them to complete the doodle collection.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2949230/Doodle_Harmony_Idle_Merge/
